scope.analysis_inputs: Only the five permitted feedback tasks' available traces/dossiers and published aggregate selection metrics. No additional selection or heldback traces/assertions inspected.

overall_observations.interpretation: These failures were not explained by exhausting the configured step/time/model budgets. Domain reasoning and artifact validation remain separate limitations.

findings.strength: Direct command and diagnostic evidence for the empty artifact; related shell mistakes recur but do not explain every failed task.

observed.fact: The command printed structured data, closed its heredoc, then ran a standalone output redirection followed by cat. The later feedback diagnostic reports JSON decoding of an empty string. A standalone redirection truncates the file instead of capturing the earlier program output.

A redirection was placed on the heredoc closing delimiter, producing an unterminated-heredoc warning and Python SyntaxError. A later command repaired that syntax, so this earlier error alone does not explain the final failure.

A producer was piped into a Python process whose stdin was already assigned to its heredoc script. JSONDecodeError and EPIPE followed. A later file-based read repaired this invocation; insufficient extraction coverage remained a separate failure.

not_established: The printed values in candidate2 were not independently proven to satisfy the full benchmark; avoiding artifact emptying is a necessary repair, not a guaranteed pass.
A general heredoc guard may introduce false positives or another model round trip; no new candidate benefit has yet been measured.
findings.why_previous_context_missed_it: The optimizer received incumbent failure dossiers only. Rejected versions supplied aggregate outcomes, so candidate2's empty-artifact failure was unavailable to the next proposal. The old 240-character command prefix also omitted the decisive closing delimiter and trailing redirection.
findings.implemented_fix: Command excerpts now retain head and tail (800-character bound), plus original length. Bounded recent rejected-feedback dossiers are supplied with source/decision provenance, including through compatible prior-job snapshots. Failure excerpts preserve the diagnostic origin and ending.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Evidence supports testing a general shell-I/O diagnostic or artifact read-back mechanism; the optimizer still must propose it and the unchanged evaluator must measure it.

findings.strength: Observed preservation-check outcomes contradict the proposed collateral-damage explanation.

not_established: The repeated claim that these runs damaged unrelated files is unsupported.
The final failure cannot be attributed solely to output truncation: incomplete discovery, restrictive searches and reasoning choices are competing explanations.
findings.why_previous_context_missed_it: Short output tails emphasize a failed replacement comparison. The proposer extrapolated a causal story instead of reconciling it with the passing preservation outcome. Merely retaining a rejection reason does not validate the hypothesis.
findings.implemented_fix: The proposer now explicitly separates observations from causal hypotheses, must cite relevant commands/diagnostics and acknowledge counterevidence, and is told not to infer collateral modifications when preservation checks passed. Larger bounded diagnostic excerpts improve access to the underlying evidence.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Natural-language grounding remains a model behavior, not a formal proof. Full benchmark-specific solutions are deliberately not embedded in the general agent.

findings.strength: The intended branch did not run in the four screened feedback observations; the exact missing prerequisite is not individually identified by saved traces.

observed.fact: Candidate3 conditionally probed the hidden verifier directory and local pytest before accepting completion. All four saved feedback traces reached normal tool-free completion after commands, contained no earlier pytest invocation, and contained none of its automatic-verification feedback. Given this exact source, those observations indicate its skip path.

not_established: The saved trace alone does not distinguish an absent verifier directory from an absent pytest executable.
There is no evidence that this automatic test mechanism improved any observation.
findings.why_previous_context_missed_it: The old system prompt prohibited hidden tests, but the runtime capabilities did not explicitly explain that grading files arrive only after the agent finishes. The proposer nevertheless assumed they would be available.
findings.implemented_fix: Explicit runtime capabilities explain fresh shell invocations, persistent trial filesystem state, and unavailable hidden verifier tests/results during execution. The proposer is forbidden to probe benchmark verifier paths and must use task-visible inputs or self-created checks.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: This is a proposer contract, not a new security boundary or a semantic verifier for arbitrary generated source. Runtime sandboxing and grading are unchanged.

findings.strength: Complete fresh matched aggregate evidence; no selection or heldback traces were used in this analysis.

fresh_confirmation.order: B/C/C/B; same three selection tasks; two repetitions per source

not_established: A three-task preliminary improvement is not a reliable gain estimate.
The confirmation does not isolate whether source changes or provider randomness caused each difference, nor establish broad statistical generalization.
findings.why_previous_context_missed_it: A preliminary scoreboard is noisy; adding more diagnostic text cannot eliminate stochastic task execution.
findings.implemented_fix: No evaluation change was made for this finding. Fresh matched confirmation and the original quality/cost/latency policy remain mandatory; the baseline was correctly retained.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Future candidates require their own complete fresh measurements. All tasks in the new study are repeated development tasks, not a new untouched holdout.
